claims.object_value: 1,258 patents incl 123 invention patents; 2,465 pending applications

claims.claim_text: ZEEKR announced a plan to integrate NVIDIA DRIVE Thor, the 2,000 TOPS AV superchip, into its centralized vehicle computer for its next generation intelligent BEV.

claims.predicate: announced planned integration of NVIDIA DRIVE Thor
claims.object_value: planned DRIVE Thor integration in next-gen BEV (forward/announced)
claims.source_quote: have also announced our plan to integrate NVIDIA DRIVE Thor, the 2,000 TOPS AV superchip, into our centralized vehicle computer for our next generation intelligent BEV.

claims.claim_text: ZEEKR deploys cutting-edge autonomous driving technology by world-leading players such as Mobileye into its BEVs.
claims.subject: ZEEKR / Mobileye
claims.object_value: Mobileye ADAS/AV technology deployed in ZEEKR vehicles
claims.source_quote: We deploy into our BEVs with cutting-edge autonomous driving technology by world-leading players such as Mobileye

claims.claim_text: ZEEKR equips its vehicles (ZEEKR 009, 001 FR, 001) with CATL's Qilin battery; ZEEKR 009 was the first mass-produced BEV model equipped with CATL's Qilin battery.
claims.subject: ZEEKR / CATL
claims.predicate: uses CATL Qilin battery as battery supplier
claims.object_value: CATL Qilin battery packs (100-140 kWh) supplied for multiple ZEEKR models
claims.source_quote: we were able to equip ZEEKR 009 with CATL's latest Qilin battery, making ZEEKR 009 the first mass-produced BEV model equipped with Qilin battery, according to Frost & Sullivan.

claims.claim_text: ZEEKR vehicles are manufactured at Geely-owned plants (ZEEKR Factory in Ningbo Hangzhou Bay, Chengdu Factory, Meishan Factory); Geely Holding was ZEEKR's largest supplier for 2022 and 2023, with vehicle purchases of RMB18.6B (2022) and RMB25.6B (2023).
claims.subject: ZEEKR / Geely Group
claims.object_value: OEM manufacturing by Geely plants; RMB25,550.7M vehicle purchases in 2023
claims.source_quote: our BEVs are manufactured at the manufacturing plant in Ningbo Hangzhou Bay New Zone owned by Geely Holding (the ZEEKR Factory ) ... and Geely Holding was our largest supplier for 2022 and 2023. ... Our purchase of vehicles amounted to RMB1,626.0 million, RMB18,605.1 million and RMB25,550.7 million in 2021, 2022 and 2023, respectively.

claims.claim_text: ZEEKR had 16,645 employees as of December 31, 2023 (15,859 in mainland China, 786 in Europe), including a Sweden-based R&D center (CEVT).
claims.subject: ZEEKR Intelligent Technology
claims.predicate: employs workforce / operates Sweden R&D center

claims.source_quote: As of December 31, 2021, 2022 and 2023, we had 7,749, 12,955 and 16,645 employees, respectively. ... 786 of our employees were based in Europe. Substantially all of the overseas research and development staff are those engaged by CEVT in Sweden.
